info.title: Cooldown Counter API
info.description: Django sessions, permission-scoped fleets, cooldown evidence and policy versions.

post.description: Validate credentials once and return a generic failure when Django rejects them.
Remove authenticated session state without changing any account-owned job history.

get.description: Return the authenticated user or null; no credentials are included.
Return the token without making its HttpOnly cookie readable to JavaScript.
Return scoped identities with the caller's effective role.

post.description: Create an owner membership and rule defaults without seeding fake accounts.

get.description: Read per-account availability and server-derived per-type predictions.

post.description: Create an account only after editor permission and exact string validation.

get.description: Read the same scoped UUID selected by the operator, never a tag substring.

patch.description: Archive or rename without removing associated event/observation facts.

get.description: Keep the audit feed bounded to the latest hundred fleet mutations.
Read exact account/type filters and distinct current fleet totals.

post.description: Return 200 for an accepted identical retry and 201 for newly committed evidence.
Retain observed facts while preserving the parent event's original assessment.

get.description: Read the provisioned principals who share this workspace.

post.description: Grant an existing active operator an explicit role.

patch.description: Apply a role change after validating the last-owner invariant.

delete.description: Revoke fleet access without deleting the principal or their historical evidence.

post.description: Use entered event time rather than the browser's or demo's current date.

get.description: Retain archived names so history is never rendered as an unknown reference.

post.description: Publish the initial nonempty policy and its stable offence identity atomically.

patch.description: Reject a stale editor rather than overwrite another accepted policy change.

post.description: Archive the selected version without touching any associated evidence.
Record a new notice or return the original on an identical retry.

get.description: Confirm that this Gunicorn process can answer an HTTP request.
Return null until Beat has dispatched a task and a worker has executed it.
List the signed-in account's work or queue a validated new message.

post.description: List the signed-in account's work or queue a validated new message.

get.description: Poll a durable result without exposing another account's job IDs.
Check the API's database connection without leaking connection details.

Account.description: A fleet row with exact identity, availability and all current predictions.

AccountDetail.description: Detail adds preserved history without changing the base account response contract.

AccountInputRequest.description: Preserve the exact SteamID digit sequence and a separate display tag.

AccountUpdateRequest.description: Rename or archive an account while protecting its stable identifier and history.

ArchiveInputRequest.description: Archive only the definition version whose impact the operator reviewed.

Audit.description: An attributed mutation record without passwords, sessions or arbitrary request dumps.

AuthenticatedSession.description: A successful login always returns a real account without secret account fields.

AuthenticationError.description: Authentication failures share one generic detail without revealing account existence.

Calendar.description: Unique event/forecast facts plus clearly fleet-wide totals at one reference instant.

Csrf.description: A masked CSRF token is returned in JSON because its cookie is HttpOnly.

Event.description: An immutable offence assessment and every observation attached to that event.

EventInputRequest.description: Accept reviewed rule/history tokens and initial evidence, never a client total.

Fleet.description: A tenant summary includes the current caller's effective role.

FleetInputRequest.description: A fleet is named by its creator; its owner membership is always server-assigned.

Forecast.description: One future reduction distinguishes stored state from the next offence outcome.

Health.description: Minimal probe output deliberately excludes secrets and infrastructure details.

Heartbeat.description: Missing scheduler execution remains null rather than looking like a successful run.

Job.description: Expose durable worker output while keeping account ownership server-controlled.

JobRequest.description: Expose durable worker output while keeping account ownership server-controlled.

LoginRequest.description: Validate bounded credentials without ever serializing a password in a response.

Membership.description: A scoped provisioned principal without credentials or global user privileges.

MembershipInputRequest.description: Owners grant a provisioned operator one explicit tenant role.

MembershipUpdateRequest.description: A membership role can change without changing its user or fleet identity.

Observation.description: Observed evidence keeps its timestamp and reporting principal separate from prediction.

ObservationInputRequest.description: Append evidence to one known offence without creating another escalation event.

OffenceType.description: Stable catalogue metadata plus its current rule revision and historical usage.

Policy.description: An immutable rule version and ordered whole-minute ladder.

Prediction.description: A server-derived next-offence estimate, distinct from a saved observation.

Preview.description: An assessment and its reviewed policy/history concurrency tokens.

PreviewInputRequest.description: Calculate an assessment at the proposed issue time without modifying any evidence.

Session.description: Represent a signed-out browser with null rather than an authentication error.

TypeInputRequest.description: Describe a reason and either its game mechanism or its custom duration ladder.

TypeUpdateRequest.description: An editor supplies the reviewed policy token before publishing or renaming.

User.description: Expose only the stable identity needed by the authenticated frontend.

Warning.description: An attributed warning kept outside the account's issued cooldown history.

WarningInputRequest.description: Record a warning without requesting a predicted level or timer.
